title: The changed training stack was declared proven before fresh-stage failures caused repeated full-job retries

source.evidence_note: Observed local historical transcript; see evidence/incident.md. Source aliases map privately; Submission of these prepared files was authorized on 2026-10-11.

horizon.intervening_work: Multiple environment fixes and thirteen smoke iterations, including a Torch/vLLM change. Earlier SFT success on the former stack was carried forward as evidence for the new stack.
horizon.mechanism: Observed stale validation coverage after environment mutation and checkpoint reuse; compound error with masked inner failure and repeated retries without diagnosing the same failure (historical monitor bounded at 200 rounds). The record’s claim that smoke #13 reused a checkpoint is not yet independently pinned to its complete raw stdout.

failure.expected_behavior: Select diverse and similar examples from the extended pool, then run SFT and RL to evaluate diversification.
failure.observed_behavior: After changing the dependency stack, the assistant treated a successful multi-step RL smoke as proof of the entire SFT-to-RL chain and launched fresh SFT jobs. Those jobs repeatedly failed at a missing imported symbol while their outer launcher reported completion. A monitor resubmitted them without resolving the failure.
failure.target_predicate: See checks/README.md; task completion and target error are assessed separately.

comparison_note: No model attempt or causal control has run. A scripted faulty fixture and correct reference, where recorded, validate the checker only.
